name: UBRS: the Blackrock Altar answers the next player after its first user has left the instance (#7584)
contract: The Blackrock Altar (175706) is a one-participant summoning ritual with grouped casters. While a player channels Emberseer Object Visual (16532) at it, another use is refused because the ritual is full. Once that first user has left the instance before the ritual completed, a group member who uses the altar channels Emberseer Object Visual and the ritual completes from that member with Emberseer Start (16533).

steps.label: The group leader enters Upper Blackrock Spire by the altar
and so does the member, into the leader's instance
CONTROL: p1 is in Upper Blackrock Spire
CONTROL: p2 is in Upper Blackrock Spire
CONTROL: the Blackrock Altar is within p1's reach
CONTROL: the Blackrock Altar is within p2's reach
p1 uses the Blackrock Altar first
CONTROL: p1 channels Emberseer Object Visual
p2 uses the same altar while p1 channels
CONTROL: the full ritual refuses p2, so both players share one instance and one altar
p1 leaves the instance before the ritual completes
CONTROL: p1 is out of Upper Blackrock Spire
CONTROL: p1 left without completing the ritual
The altar drops p1's channel and becomes ready again
p2 uses the Blackrock Altar after p1 has left
CONTRACT: p2 channels Emberseer Object Visual
CONTRACT: the ritual completes from p2 with Emberseer Start
